covLW

Ledoit-Wolf Covariance Matrix Estimators

The goal of covLW is to provide a collection of statistical methods that implement linear and nonlinear shrinkage estimators for large-dimensional covariance matrices developed by Ledoit and Wolf.

Installation

You can install the development version of covLW from GitHub with:

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("Carol-seven/covLW")
